entities.summary: Technology Revolution and Hsinchu, a transformative movement in Taiwan (1980–1987). Emerged from Kaohsiung Export Processing Zone established — pioneering the export zone model and Export-Led Industrialization. Catalyzed First direct presidential election — Lee Teng-hui wins amid PRC missile threats.
